answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in comet, expire in zephyr, and quill lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 94 aliases therefore needs 115 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 120 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
